description: Decodes a pasted PEM certificate or chain: subject, issuer, validity dates, names, key, signature algorithm, fingerprints, extensions and findings, plus a chain order check. Private keys are refused.

certificate.description: One PEM certificate or a whole chain, from -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- to -----END CERTIFICATE-----. At most 10 certificates are read.

name: ssl_certificate_decoder
title: SSL certificate decoder
